questions.question: Which king of Judah is described in the first part of chapter 14?
What foolish thing did Amaziah do after defeating Edom?
options: Built a great temple for the worship of false gods
Challenged Israel to battle and was defeated
Fled away from his throne out into the desert
Made a binding treaty with the king of Egypt
questions.answer: Challenged Israel to battle and was defeated

questions.question: Jeroboam II of Israel restored the borders of Israel.
King _____ of Judah challenged Israel to battle and was defeated.
_____ II, king of Israel, restored Israel's borders during his reign.
